license_required.quote: no person shall engage in nutrition or dietetics practice, or use or include the titles or represent himself to be a dietitian, nutritionist or nutrition associate unless he is licensed under the Nutrition and Dietetics Practice Act.

issuing_authority.quote: "board" means the nutrition and dietetics practice board

name.quote: "board" means the nutrition and dietetics practice board

type.quote: "board" means the nutrition and dietetics practice board

umbrella_agency.quote: The board may contract with the regulation and licensing department for office space and administrative support.

degree_required.value: master's degree or doctorate in human nutrition, nutrition education, foods and nutrition or public health nutrition (for nutritionist); baccalaureate or higher degree (for nutrition associate); RD registration accepted for dietitian
degree_required.quote: has received a master's degree or doctorate in human nutrition, nutrition education, foods and nutrition or public health nutrition from a college or university accredited by a member of the council on post-secondary accreditation

accrediting_body.quote: from a college or university accredited by a member of the council on post-secondary accreditation

exams.name: State examination
exams.notes: Alternative pathway to licensure: applicant may pass a state examination in lieu of the standard education/credential requirements
exams.quote: the board shall issue a license to an applicant who pays all required fees and who successfully passes a state examination, as established in Subsection A of Section 61-7A-6 NMSA 1978

interval_years.quote: Every person licensed under the Nutrition and Dietetics Practice Act shall renew his license annually on or before the expiration date of the initial or renewal license.

required.quote: The board shall issue a renewal license to the licensee upon receipt of the renewal application, the renewal fee and proof satisfactory to the board of compliance with continuing education requirements.

hours_per_period.quote: at least seventy-five clock hours, or the equivalent, during a five-year period shall be required to be obtained in increments of fifteen clock hours annually

period_years.quote: at least seventy-five clock hours, or the equivalent, during a five-year period

available.quote: The board may license an applicant who is licensed as a dietitian, nutritionist or nutrition associate in another state, provided that in the judgment of the board the standards for licensure in that state are not less stringent than those provided for licensure in the Nutrition and Dietetics Practice Act.

requirements.value: Standards for licensure in the other state must not be less stringent than those in NM's Nutrition and Dietetics Practice Act.
requirements.quote: provided that in the judgment of the board the standards for licensure in that state are not less stringent than those provided for licensure in the Nutrition and Dietetics Practice Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in procuring a license under the Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is guilty of fraud or misrepresentation in the procurement of any license under the Nutrition and Dietetics Practice Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Subject to disciplinary action by another state agency regulating dietitians, nutritionists or nutrition associates
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is subject to the imposition of any disciplinary action by an agency of another state which regulates dietitians, nutritionists or nutrition associates but not to exceed the period or extent of that action

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime other than a misdemeanor
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is convicted of a crime other than a misdemeanor. The record of conviction or a certified copy of it shall be conclusive evidence of the conviction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence or incompetence in practice as a dietitian, nutritionist or nutrition associate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is grossly negligent or incompetent in his practice as a dietitian, nutritionist or nutrition associate

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to fulfill continuing education requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has failed to fulfill continuing education requirements

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated or aided/abetted any person to violate provisions of the Act or rules adopted under it
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has violated or aided or abetted any person to violate any of the provisions of the Nutrition and Dietetics Practice Act or any rules or regulations duly adopted under that act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in unethical or unprofessional conduct as defined in the board's adopted code of ethics
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has engaged in unethical or unprofessional conduct as defined in the code of ethics adopted by the board

definition_quote.value: the integration and application of principles derived from the sciences of nutrition, biochemistry, physiology, food management and behavioral and social sciences to achieve and maintain human health through the provision of nutrition care services
definition_quote.quote: "nutrition or dietetics practice" means the integration and application of principles derived from the sciences of nutrition, biochemistry, physiology, food management and behavioral and social sciences to achieve and maintain human health through the provision of nutrition care services

value: assessment of the nutritional needs of individuals and groups
establishment of priorities, goals and objectives that meet nutritional needs
provision of nutrition counseling in health and disease
development, implementation and management of nutrition care systems
evaluation, adjustment and maintenance of appropriate standards of quality in food and nutrition care
methods_authorized.quote: "nutrition care services" means: (1) assessment of the nutritional needs of individuals and groups and determining resources and constraints in the practice setting; (2) establishment of priorities, goals and objectives that meet nutritional needs in a manner consistent with available resources and constraints; (3) provision of nutrition counseling in health and disease; (4) development, implementation and management of nutrition care systems; and (5) evaluation, adjustment and maintenance of appropriate standards of quality in food and nutrition care

value: licensed dietitian
licensed nutritionist
licensed nutrition associate
license_type_structure.quote: The board shall issue a license as a dietitian ... The board shall issue a license as a nutritionist ... The board shall issue a license as a nutrition associate

provisional_license_available.quote: A provisional permit to practice as a dietitian or nutritionist may be issued by the board upon the filing of an application and submission of evidence of successful completion of the education requirements.

dietetic_technician_recognized.quote: prevent a dietetic technician registered (DTR) from engaging in nutrition or dietetics practice under the supervision of a licensed dietitian or licensed nutritionist

rd_credential_accepted_in_lieu_of_state_.quote: The board shall issue a license as a dietitian to any person who files a completed application, pays all required fees and certifies and furnishes evidence satisfactory to the board that the applicant has a valid current registration with the commission that gives the applicant the right to use the term "registered dietitian" or "R.D.".

alternative_credential_pathways.quote: maintains membership in one of the following organizations: (a) the American institute of nutrition; (b) the American society for clinical nutrition; or (c) the American board of nutrition

enteral_parenteral_nutrition_authorized.quote: "nutritional assessment" means the evaluation of the nutritional needs of individuals and groups based upon appropriate biochemical, anthropometric, physical and dietary data to determine nutrient needs and recommend appropriate nutritional intake, including enteral and parenteral nutrition

exempt_professions_list.quote: Nothing in the Nutrition and Dietetics Practice Act is intended to: (1) limit, interfere with or prevent any other licensed health care professional from engaging in nutrition and dietetics practice within the limits of his licensure

federal_employee_exemption.quote: limit, interfere with or prevent employees of state or federal agencies from using the term "dietitian" or "nutritionist" as defined in state or federal personnel qualifications where these terms are used in their job titles, except that the use of these terms shall be limited to the period and practice of their employment with the state or federal agency establishing those qualifications

weight_control_program_exemption.quote: prevent any person from providing weight control services provided the program has been reviewed by, consultation is available from and no program change can be initiated without prior approval by a licensed dietitian or licensed nutritionist

food_supplement_sales_exemption.quote: prevent an individual who does not hold himself out as a dietitian, nutritionist or nutrition associate from furnishing oral or written nutritional information on food, food materials or dietary supplements or from engaging in the explanation to customers about foods or food products in connection with the marketing and distribution of those products
